title: Improper Neutralization of Script-Related HTML Tags in a Web Page (Basic XSS) vulnerability in PluginUs.Net HUSKY…
description: A Cross-Site Scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in PluginUs.Net HUSKY woocommerce-products-filter versions up to 1.4.7. This vulnerability involves improper neutralization of script-related HTML tags, allowing code injection. The vulnerability has a CVSS score of 5.3, indicating a medium severity level.
